items.title: Overnight

items.title: Special needs

items.title: Event childcare
items.body: Group care for weddings, parties and conferences.

points.title: Vetted, not just listed

points.title: Booked around you

points.title: Happy-kid guarantee
points.body: If a sitting doesn't go well, the next one is on us.

items.name: Sample parent A.
items.quote: Our sitter showed up early, had the kids in bed on time and left a note about the night. We finally had a real date.

items.name: Sample parent B.
items.quote: Booked at 2pm, had a sitter by 6. She was calm, kind and the kids keep asking when she is coming back.

items.name: Sample parent C.
items.quote: The after-school pickup has made our weekdays so much easier. Reliable every single time.

cta.heading: Ready for a night off?
cta.body: Tell us when you need care and we will match you with a sitter in {{groupName}} within 24 hours.

footer.blurb: {{businessName}} connects {{regionName}} families with trusted, background-checked sitters. Sample content for demonstration.

faq.question: How are sitters screened?
faq.answer: Every sitter passes an interview, reference checks, a national background check and CPR certification before their first booking.

faq.question: How fast can I book?
faq.answer: Most families are matched within 24 hours. For tonight, call before noon.

faq.question: What does it cost?
faq.answer: Rates depend on the number of children and the time of day. Call {{phone}} for a quote.

faq.question: Do you serve my area?
faq.answer: We serve families across {{regionName}}. Call us to confirm your neighborhood.
